superseded_run: 20e029d = aborted pre-fetch, no document selected, no corpus derived from it
design_change_rationale: The v1 defect was the DOCUMENT TYPE, not the sentence threshold: a long-form length requirement was applied to landing/index pages. v2 changes the corpus unit to institutional long-form documents. The 1200-sentence figure came from a corpus-size assumption, not a methodological necessity, so it is replaced by a realistic mechanical minimum plus an explicit corpus-size target.
unchanged: 12 domains, no domain added, dropped or reordered
no Wikipedia, no news, no blogs, no marketing, no advocacy/opinion
no keyword search for provide/support/serve and no construction-frequency targeting
no difficulty estimation, no selection by pipeline output
K=3 candidates per domain, first qualifying candidate wins
mechanical filters only: 40-400 chars, >=6 tokens, terminal punctuation, boilerplate/markup removal
section-wise sampling (stride per section, never per document)
no per-document sentence cap and no document-size balancing
pinning of url + fetch_date + raw sha256, corpus digest before inference
N=80 deterministic seeded sample drawn AFTER the full run
one variable changed at a time: v2 changes document type and minimum size only

document_requirement.type: institutional long-form document (full report, standard, plan, guidance document, technical specification, results report) - NOT a landing page, index page, press release or news item
document_requirement.qualification_check: after cleaning and structural-section removal, the document must expose at least 300 usable sentences AND at least 3 real content sections; else next K candidate; if none of K qualifies, the shortfall is recorded and the domain continues with the next K batch (never with a different domain)

corpus_size.mechanism: one global sampling ratio r = 200 / (sum of usable sentences across all selected documents), applied UNIFORMLY to every document and every section
corpus_size.why_not_per_document_cap: a single global ratio keeps relative document sizes intact (a 1200-sentence document still contributes 6x a 200-sentence one) while hitting the corpus target; a per-document cap would be document balancing, which is forbidden
corpus_size.no_equilibration: document size differences are preserved; the ratio is a corpus-size mechanism, not a balance mechanism
corpus_size.cost_note: the full pipeline run is executed over the resulting ~200 sentences, so validator call volume stays comparable to batch 6; the N=80 sample is drawn from that run, not from the 24 raw documents

procedure: 1. per domain: fixed query restricted to long-form institutional documents, K=3
2. mechanical allowlist filter (institutional domains only; social/commercial excluded without judgement)
3. scrape candidates in K order; first with >=300 usable sentences and >=3 sections qualifies
4. take two qualifying documents per domain, recording any shortfall
5. pin url + fetch_date + raw markdown sha256 per document
6. section-wise stride with the single global ratio r
7. compute corpus digest and verify disjointness vs corpora v1-v6 and frozen test material
9. run the unchanged production pipeline v1.2.1 over the whole corpus
10. freeze all run records, then draw the seeded N=80 sample
11. blind annotation, then answer the replication question
forbidden: no document re-selection after seeing pipeline output
no per-document balancing or sentence caps
no corpus edits after the digest is pinned
no reuse of the aborted pre-fetch candidates as the corpus
